fato_historico: 1953: Soldiers from the 2nd Battalion, Royal Australian Regiment repel a number of Chinese assaults against a key position known as The Hook during the Battle of the Samichon River, just hours before the Armistice Agreement is signed, ending the Korean War.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may find your inner strength reflected in the courage of those who protected their peace before the dawn of a truce. Consider this a time to fortify your emotional boundaries. Perhaps it is a good time to turn away from conflict and embrace the gentle shelter of your own heart's quiet sanctuary.
frase_do_dia: Your kindness is the anchor that keeps you steady in turbulent waters.
significado_numero: Represents the delicate balance between inner intuition and outer reality.
conselho: Trust your gut feelings and protect your peace like a hidden treasure today.
